generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In `#GH21C`, there is a hardcoded value `nFieldsForParsingApiKeyInfo = 13`. While this creates a maintenance dependency on `ApiKey.initializeParser`, the implementation mitigates this risk by performing a runtime check (`if (nFieldsForParsingApiKeyInfo != nParsedFields)`) that will fail fast during initialization if the counts diverge.
